Otterly Maths Path

Learn maths one small step at a time

Pick your class. Each chapter has five steps: see it, try it, practise it, print it, check it. Pass the check to move on.

Progress is saved on this device only.

How a chapter works

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

Class 1 is ready now. The other classes are planned below and will be added one at a time. We only show a lesson when it is finished.

How progress is saved

Your passes and printed sheets are saved on this device only, in your browser's local storage. There are no accounts, no cookies, no ads and no tracking. If you clear your browser data, your progress is removed. A different browser or device starts fresh.
